old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-jfzk","title":"TX-path error logging mislabels policy rejections as corruption: lichen_l2_tx crash_info_store(CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION) for every negative lichen_link_tx return","description":"Found by security codereview pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-wrxl (P3, pre-existing pattern; the new SCHC_ERR_INVALID_ENDPOINT=-15 from wrxl now flows through it). lichen/subsys/lichen/link/l2/lichen_l2_tx.c:154 calls crash_info_store(CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION, __LINE__, (uint32_t)(-ret)) for EVERY negative return from lichen_link_tx, so a legitimate caller-input policy rejection (e.g. -15 emission-policy) is persisted to flash as 'corruption code 15' - conflating caller-address errors with memory corruption and costing flash wear if a node repeatedly tries to send policy-invalid datagrams. Inputs are node-local so no remote trigger today. Also lichen_util.h lichen_link_strerror has no SCHC-code cases (logs 'unknown error'). Fix: classify SCHC_ERR_* (and other caller-input rejections) distinctly from CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION (e.g. a CRASH_STATE_REJECT that does not persist, or drop the crash_info call for -EINVAL-class codes), and consider teaching lichen_link_strerror the SCHC codes; keep fail-closed behavior unchanged (datagram still dropped).","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-08-30T22:06:40.622582725Z","created_by":"opencode-worker-1","updated_at":"2026-08-30T22:06:40.622582725Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-jfzk","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-wrxl","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-08-30T22:06:40.746300162Z","created_by":"opencode-worker-1","metadata":"{}"}]}

new_value: TX rejections are no longer mislabeled as corruption. (1) New LICHEN_ESCHC (201, following the LICHEN_EAUTH=200 convention): lichen_link_tx maps SCHC policy/structural rejections to it instead of passing raw -1..-15 codes that collide with POSIX errno values; BUFFER_TOO_SMALL stays passthrough (internal sizing anomaly). (2) lichen_l2_tx skips crash_info_store(CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION) for -LICHEN_ESCHC and -ENOKEY (operational rejections: dropped datagram, unkeyed state); genuine anomalies (zero-length frame, oversized frame, transport failures) keep the corruption record. Fail-closed unchanged: drop + LOG_ERR + tx_stat; lichen_l2_to_zephyr_errno maps -LICHEN_ESCHC -> -EINVAL. (3) lichen_link_strerror teaches both codes (ESCHC guarded by HAVE_LICHEN_ERRNO; ENOKEY by #ifdef for CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK=n builds - fixing the P1 Zephyr build break the review found). (4) ENOKEY fixed to the Linux/asm-generic value 126 (was ENOENT=2 in the host subsys build vs 126 on glibc/Zephyr - order-dependent divergence found by the new host test); normalized the six local #ifndef ENOKEY fallback sites (announce.c, app_identity.c, gateway_identity.c, meshcore_adapter.c, 2 test mains) to 126 so all TUs agree. (5) Host pins in l2_key_selection: policy-invalid packet (loopback src, valid checksum) through lichen_link_tx -> -LICHEN_ESCHC with frame_len untouched; keyless ctx -> -ENOKEY. Verified on heft: l2_key_selection all green (clang+ASan/UBSan), link_epoch_host green, cppcheck clean on touched files (one pre-existing cppcheck directive complaint in untouched ipv6_addr.h). 3x codereview: no P0-P2 left on the delta after fixes; findings filed: 1tpy (P2 vendored firmware/bridge-zephyr copy still carries the mislabel + raw-code leak - needs Zephyr env to verify), 50t0 (P3 pre-existing 256-264B unmatched-packet BUFFER_TOO_SMALL class still corruption-labeled). Known limitation: tests/app_identity and tests/meshcore_gateway_adapter are Zephyr-only suites - the alias normalization there is compile-mirrored by app_identity.c but not host-verified (Zephyr env unavailable on heft). Pre-existing explicit_bzero host-clang failures in link_ctx/link_relay/link_crypto unrelated (untouched files), noted for a follow-up.
